brandTitle: AI Skills Library: Valuable AI Skills for Every Scenario

hero.title: AI Skills Official Website Guide
hero.alt: AI Skills Official Website Scene Guide
hero.description: Unified entry to AI Skills official website, supporting skill search by profession, industry and use case.

workflowSteps.title: Scan to Login
workflowSteps.alt: Scan to login AI Skills account
workflowSteps.description: First complete scan login on AI Skills official website to ensure API Key, installation commands, and skill calls are all bound to the same account.

workflowSteps.title: Apply for API Key
workflowSteps.alt: Apply for API Key on AI Skills site
workflowSteps.description: After login, go to API Key page to apply for a key. Both CLI installation and skill execution will read AISKILLS_API_KEY.

workflowSteps.title: Copy Installation Command
workflowSteps.alt: Copy AI Skills skill installation command
workflowSteps.description: Copy the installation command from AI Skills official website, skills.sh, or ClawHub page. Prefer using the official CLI to avoid manual parameter stitching.

workflowSteps.title: Execute Installation Command
workflowSteps.alt: Execute AI Skills installation command in terminal
workflowSteps.description: Return to terminal and execute the installation command. CLI will write AISKILLS_API_KEY and call the downstream skills add to complete skill installation.

workflowSteps.title: Successfully Obtain Skill
workflowSteps.alt: AI Skills skill installation success interface
workflowSteps.description: After successful installation, you will see the corresponding Skill in your agent's skill list. You can call it directly and replicate it in your workflow.
